I dropped my car off in Dec for paint/ ceramic coating. When talking with John it would be around $4,000 for it all and he said in January it would be done. I was polite, waited, and never rushed him. Then in February he finally texted me and said the car wouldn’t start and needed a fuel pump. The car was always running when I dropped it off, but whatever. I’m thinking because they leave cars in the open the gas was siphoned. He installed a new fuel pump, then my car continued to sit as he ignored the paint job and prioritized other work. Then his team had to jump start my car because they continued to let it sit there and his team reversed the cables and ruined the ECM! That is insane! He purchased a used one online, first got the wrong one so a further delay, and then when the car was finally operating again, he still did not prioritize my car and it sat there. He had said once it was running it would be the first car painted, so he clearly lied like he had numerous times when I was checking in weekly about when this would be done, let alone actually start. It was not until May that I got it back and then he said it was around $8,000. Way over what he said months earlier!
I write this review because within months my car would die while driving it! This happened numerous times. I could have died. I never thought it would be related to his team, but it 100% was. I took it to numerous mechanics who couldn’t diagnose anything wrong with it, until saying it must be the ECM. I purchased one online, previously John told me how when he bought that one it was over $1,000, they are not anywhere close to that. I got one for around $200 which I know is what he did because he said all he did was plug and play. No dealership programming. This only lasted about a month and then the car began to die again. I had to take it to the dealer and pay their price for them to thoroughly diagnose my car. They had to program the ECM to my car, those aftermarket services never get the programming right and dealers have to do it they said. This is something John should have done and paid for rather than the mere plug and play that he did. I had to pay over $1,000 for this. They also said I needed a new battery and once I told them what this body shop did, he said they should have gotten a new battery if they fried the ECM and let it sit for 6 months. The battery cells were naturally dead.
Then I had to take it to the dealer again because the car would shut off at idle. This diagnosis was that the fuel pump wiring was exposed. So when John did that repair it wasn’t even good work!
He cost me so much money over shoddy work he did. I’ve called and emailed and he ignores me. He owes me thousands of dollars at this point and knowing his integrity he will never respond. He was never even polite about ignoring my car for 6 months. Each time I was in there I saw people battling him about issues from when they had left their car with him.
